import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62_ROWS="""4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
M={}
for i,row in enumerate(B62_ROWS.strip().split("\n")):
    for k,v in enumerate(row.split()):
        M[(AA[i],AA[k])]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return M.get((a,b), -4)

def nw(s1,s2,gap_open=-11,gap_ext=-1):
    """Affine-gap Needleman-Wunsch (Gotoh). Returns aligned strings."""
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-10**9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=gap_open+(i-1)*gap_ext; pX[i,0]=1
    for k in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,k]=gap_open+(k-1)*gap_ext; pY[0,k]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for k in range(1,m+1):
            b=s2[k-1]; s=sc(a,b)
            prev=(Mm[i-1,k-1],Ix[i-1,k-1],Iy[i-1,k-1]); j=int(np.argmax(prev))
            Mm[i,k]=prev[j]+s; pM[i,k]=j
            cx=(Mm[i-1,k]+gap_open, Ix[i-1,k]+gap_ext); jx=int(np.argmax(cx))
            Ix[i,k]=cx[jx]; pX[i,k]=0 if jx==0 else 1
            cy=(Mm[i,k-1]+gap_open, Iy[i,k-1]+gap_ext); jy=int(np.argmax(cy))
            Iy[i,k]=cy[jy]; pY[i,k]=0 if jy==0 else 2
    i,k=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or k>0:
        if state==0:
            A.append(s1[i-1]); B.append(s2[k-1]); state=int(pM[i,k]); i-=1; k-=1
        elif state==1:
            A.append(s1[i-1]); B.append("-"); state=int(pX[i,k]); i-=1
        else:
            A.append("-"); B.append(s2[k-1]); state=int(pY[i,k]); k-=1
        if i==0 and k>0: state=2
        if k==0 and i>0: state=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)), "".join(reversed(B))

KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
      'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def fa(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

orthos={"Homo sapiens":"A1A4G5","Mus musculus":"A0A1B0GSK3","Rattus norvegicus":"A0ABK0KX35",
        "Bos taurus":"A0AAA9TK01","Sus scrofa":"A0A4X1UTK7","Dromaius novaehollandiae":"A0A8C4JKW8",
        "Pelodiscus sinensis":"K7F818","Eleutherodactylus coqui":"A0A8J6KAS9",
        "Danio rerio":"A0AC58JVB0","Petromyzon marinus":"A0ACM8BTF7"}
seqs={k:fa(v) for k,v in orthos.items()}; hum=seqs["Homo sapiens"]
cons=np.zeros(len(hum)); n=0; rows=[]
for sp,s in seqs.items():
    if sp=="Homo sapiens": continue
    a,b=nw(hum,s); hi=-1; match=np.zeros(len(hum),bool)
    for ca,cb in zip(a,b):
        if ca!="-":
            hi+=1
            if ca==cb: match[hi]=True
    cons+=match; n+=1
    rows.append(dict(species=sp, acc=orthos[sp], length=len(s),
        pct_id_to_human=round(100*match.sum()/len(hum),1),
        id_aromatic_patch_9_23=round(100*match[8:23].mean(),1),
        id_charged_helix_131_157=round(100*match[130:157].mean(),1),
        maxKD19=round(max(sum(KD.get(x,0) for x in s[i:i+19])/19 for i in range(len(s)-18)),2)))
cons/=n
t=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("pct_id_to_human",ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",220); print(t.to_string(index=False))
t.to_csv("out/LNP1_ortholog_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("\nWhole protein mean conservation: %.1f%%" % (100*cons.mean()))
print("Aromatic patch 9-23 (DDVSFAKWMSSFWGH): %.1f%%" % (100*cons[8:23].mean()))
print("Charged helix 131-157: %.1f%%" % (100*cons[130:157].mean()))
kd19=np.array([sum(KD.get(x,0) for x in hum[i:i+19])/19 for i in range(len(hum)-18)])
c19=np.array([cons[i:i+19].mean() for i in range(len(hum)-18)])
best=int(c19.argmax())
print("Most conserved 19-aa block: %d-%d, %.0f%% id, KD %.2f -> %s" % (best+1,best+19,100*c19[best],kd19[best],hum[best:best+19]))
print("Pearson r(conservation, hydropathy) over 19-aa windows: %.3f" % np.corrcoef(c19,kd19)[0,1])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,6),sharex=True)
ax[0].bar(np.arange(1,len(hum)+1),100*cons,color="#1F618D",width=1.0)
ax[0].axvspan(9,23,color="#F9E79F",alpha=.7); ax[0].axvspan(131,157,color="#D5F5E3",alpha=.7)
ax[0].text(16,104,"9-23 aromatic patch",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].text(144,104,"131-157 charged helix",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].set_ylim(0,118); ax[0].set_ylabel("% identity to human\n(9 vertebrate orthologs)")
ax[0].set_title("LNP1 conservation does not track hydrophobicity: no conserved membrane-embeddable block", fontsize=10)
ax[1].plot(np.arange(1,len(kd19)+1)+9,kd19,color="#C0392B",lw=1.5)
ax[1].axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="k",lw=1); ax[1].text(3,1.7,"TM threshold (KD 1.6)",fontsize=8)
ax[1].axhline(0,ls=":",color="grey",lw=.8)
ax[1].axvspan(9,23,color="#F9E79F",alpha=.7); ax[1].axvspan(131,157,color="#D5F5E3",alpha=.7)
ax[1].set_ylim(-3.2,2.0); ax[1].set_xlabel("human LNP1 residue"); ax[1].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\n19-aa window")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
